title: Categories
permissionNote: Only administrators can modify categories. You can still review the catalog.

essential.title: Create an easy-to-recognize group
essential.description: Use a simple name, such as Beverages, Bakery, or Cleaning.

advanced.title: Organization and description
advanced.description: Place this category inside another group or add a note.

unsavedChanges.title: Discard category changes?
unsavedChanges.status: Category changes have not been saved

fields.name: Category name
fields.parentHelp: Leave this unchanged unless the category belongs inside another group.

delete.title: Delete Category
delete.description: Delete this category? Move its subcategories and remove provider assignments first.
